title: Error results skip the after-hook — on_execute_tool_error fires instead; result is null

mitigation_ref.description: GuardedProxy wraps execute directly, so it intercepts the call regardless of which nanobot hook path fires on error.

title: Every MCP tool defaults to read_only=False (state-changing) in nanobot

mitigation_ref.description: surface.json provides the authoritative action-class label per tool; ToolFence never relies on nanobot's read_only flag.

title: Sub-agents run with _SubagentHook only — Guard hooks never fire during sub-agent turns

mitigation_ref.description: The spawn tool is unregistered from the nanobot registry after Guard setup, preventing sub-agent turns entirely.

title: Dream turns are ephemeral — registered hooks are skipped for dream/memory turns

mitigation_ref.description: Dream turns are disabled via agents.defaults.dream.enabled: false in nanobot config, removing the bypass path.

title: The !-shell exec tool calls tool.execute() directly, bypassing all hooks

mitigation_ref.description: The exec tool is not registered in the nanobot registry, so it is unavailable to the agent.

title: MCP reconnect silently replaces Guard proxies with bare MCPToolWrapper instances

mitigation_ref.description: Guard re-wraps every mcp_* entry after each reconnect, and a per-turn invariant check blocks the turn if any bare wrapper is detected.

title: Large results saved to workspace files lose their trust labels unless Guard tracks the file path

mitigation_ref.description: ProvenanceStore records path-to-label mappings so a later read_file call inherits the original trust label; coverage depends on Guard being wired before the workspace write.

title: Empty quote schema caused the model to refuse the create_quote call

mitigation_ref.description: Galaxium patch 0001 exposes named fields in the create_quote MCP tool schema, eliminating the empty-schema refusal.

title: Agent used the shell (exec) to work around a missing tool schema

mitigation_ref.description: The exec tool is unregistered from the nanobot registry, removing this bypass path; patch 0001 also eliminates the schema gap that prompted the workaround.

title: Coached agent invented an untraceable traveller ID; the pass verdict gave no signal

mitigation_ref.description: ProvenanceStore labels any value not traceable to a user message or first-party result as untrusted (fail-closed), so fabricated IDs trigger the Guard card rule.

title: Unrequested register_user calls appeared in 5 of 10 clean runs — autonomous side-effect behaviour

mitigation_ref.description: The narrowing fix removes register_user from the nanobot enabled_tools list, so the tool is not available to the agent during normal or evaluation runs.

title: Error results confirmed live: register_user returning HTTP 409 yielded result: null in the trace

mitigation_ref.description: GuardedProxy wraps execute directly and captures the result regardless of the nanobot hook path taken on error, so null results are still labelled correctly.

title: ssrfWhitelist configuration required for nanobot to reach a localhost MCP server

mitigation_ref.description: The required ssrfWhitelist entry is documented in docs/setup.md; no code change is needed as this is a deployment configuration concern.
